report.limitations: Training includes weak labels inferred from the college Bloom verb list. GATE 2023 is a held-out paper year, but its labels are also verb-inferred, not faculty-verified. These scores measure agreement with the verb heuristic, not question correctness or educational quality.

dataSource: Hand-authored examples plus weakly labeled GATE CS 2022 question stems; GATE CS 2023 held out by year
